subject: BUG-257 (LIVE): 13 PIS labs ship literal CTF flags in client-side config.js and award them client-side
description:
PROVEN by Mallory during the HEXOS-6 vote, and I re-verified against PRODUCTION with an unauthenticated cache-busted curl: https://hexworth.com/houses/shield/infosec/labs/pis-l02-human-vector-drill/config.js returns literal FLAG{...} values today. 13 files match: _app/houses/shield/infosec/labs/pis-*/config.js (pis-l01 through pis-l12, pis-m2). Grading is ALSO client-side: engine.awardFlag('flag1') at config.js:337 and awardFlag('flag2') at :355, with no validateFlag / ctfSubmitFlag call anywhere in the path. So a student can read the flag out of the page source and award it to themselves without doing the lab, and nothing server-side ever checks. CONTRAST with the Arena, which does this correctly: _app/arena/boxes/*/config.js stores '{{FLAG:root}}' placeholders and BoxEngine.resolveFlag() substitutes server-derived truth at runtime. So the placeholder pattern exists and works; this lab family simply never adopted it. This is the never-client-grade rule (feedback_no_client_grading_ever) violated in a family nobody swept, because the earlier 'flags live in Firestore' conclusion was drawn from the Arena and generalised. NOT introduced by anything recent and NOT a HEXOS-6 problem: it is live right now. Fix direction: move these 13 to the placeholder + server-resolve pattern the Arena already uses. Any rotation must also assume the current values are burned.
[2026-09-05 20:23] REFRAMED after investigation. The original headline (read the flag, award it to yourself) does NOT hold: all 14 PIS labs declare a registryId, submitFlag routes through the server-side validateFlag, and BoxEngine hashes flag values with a per-session seed rather than comparing cleartext. Also ZERO of the 14 expose a flag-submit UI at all; they auto-award. So knowing the literal value buys nothing. What IS real: (a) the literal values are readable in page source, which spoils the reward but grants no points, and (b) the far more serious finding underneath, now BUG-260: four labs have no flag_registry doc at all, so every capture is silently rejected server-side. Mallory's file-count of 1,583 lab-skill-maps was RIGHT and my initial 34 was wrong; I had counted only the top level. Keep this open for the literal-value disclosure, which should move to the Arena's {{FLAG:id}} placeholder pattern, but it is no longer the urgent half.
